pins.title: White Noise Machine Without Light: 3 Sound Machines With No Glow or a Display You Can Switch Off
pins.subtitle: When the sound machine is the brightest thing in the room
pins.description: Got the bedroom dark, then noticed a green dot or a clock display glowing on the nightstand? If you're looking for a white noise machine without light, this guide covers two real-fan machines that Yogasleep describes as having no screen (Dohm Classic and Dohm Uno), plus the Loftie Clock, which has a display and night light you can black out with Blackout Mode. Based on manufacturer specs and published product info. Read the full guide. #whitenoisemachine #soundmachine #darkbedroom #bedroomideas #sleepsetup #nightstand

pins.title: Sound Machine No Lights: Dohm Classic vs Dohm Uno vs Loftie Clock
pins.subtitle: Which one can go dark?
pins.description: Comparing a sound machine with no lights to one you can switch off? Yogasleep Dohm Classic: real fan, two speeds, and Yogasleep says "No screens or blue light", with no night light listed. Yogasleep Dohm Uno: real fan, single speed, 6-foot cord, described as "No Apps. No Screens." Loftie Clock: a clock display and night light, 100+ sounds including white and brown noise, and a Blackout Mode (press and hold snooze) that turns the screen off; the night light toggles separately. Yogasleep's pages don't mention an indicator light either way, so check the listing photos. See the full comparison table. #soundmachine #whitenoisemachine #darkbedroom #sleepsetup #bedroomideas

pins.title: White Noise Machine Without Light: 5 Things to Check in the Listing Before You Buy
pins.subtitle: Dimmable is not the same as off
pins.description: Save this checklist before you buy a white noise machine without light. 1) Is there a light besides the night light, such as a power or status indicator? 2) Can it be turned off, and how: a button, an app, or not at all? 3) Does the display light up again when you touch it? 4) Does it glow while charging? 5) Does the listing only say "dimmable"? If so, it may not go fully dark. If the manufacturer doesn't say, treat it as unknown rather than as no light. Full checklist in the guide. #soundmachine #whitenoisemachine #darkbedroom #bedroomchecklist #sleepsetup #bedroomideas

pins.title: Sound Machine No Lights? How to Cut the Glow From the One You Already Own
pins.subtitle: Tape the dot, never the vents
pins.description: Not ready to replace your sound machine? Before shopping for a sound machine with no lights, try this. Check the manual for a built-in way to turn lights off first. Turn the lit side toward the wall, set it lower than your head on a stable surface, or put a book or lamp base in the line of sight. If you use opaque tape, read your manual's warnings, cover only the indicator light, and keep tape off vents, air openings, the power adapter, and anything that gets warm. Don't drape a cloth over the machine, and never cover a smoke detector. Read the full guide. #soundmachine #whitenoisemachine #darkbedroom #bedroomtips #sleepsetup #nightstand
